newsitem.title: GERMANY: German cocoa trader notes weak chocolate exports.
newsitem.headline: German cocoa trader notes weak chocolate exports.

text.p: Export orders for German chocolate products have weakened and this has lengthened the industry's raw materials cover, cocoa trader Albrecht & Dill (A&D) said in a weekly market report.
Sales revenues at chocolate manufacturing companies had fallen, which had discouraged cocoa buying, while lower capacity utilisation also hampered new orders.
But processor stocks were still historically low, A&D said.
Fresh buying signals would be sharply lower cash and sterling prices versus the mark but they were not in sight.
London futures were last rising and sterling showed sustained firmness.
